rows.en: Yamato: "...Everyone will be here soon."
Touya: "Yeah. By the way, where did those old men go?
They disappeared when I wasn't looking..."
Yamato: "They don't seem to be enemies..."
Touya: "Well, they'll show up again if they need to."
Yamato: "But about that mech called Aidion...
It's strange that the explosion was that small.
I can only think that mech absorbed it."
Touya: "Can it do that?"
Yamato: "An ordinary mech couldn't. Right, Celica?"
Celica: "..."
Yamato: "Celica...?"
Celica: "Huh? Wh-What?"
Touya: "What's wrong? You've been acting strange for a while."
Celica: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Ah, it looks like everyone's arrived."
Touya: "Anyway, once we've joined up with everyone,
tell us what's going on."
Celica: "Y-Yeah. All right..."
Kasumi: "...Touya-chan, is it all over now?"
Touya: "Yeah. Probably. The people in the capital seem normal,
and that drug's effects don't seem to last forever."
Kasumi: "...I'm glad. We'll be joining up with everyone
soon, too..."
Yamato: "Right. They said in that last transmission
that they'd be here soon."
Touya: "By the way, where did those old men go?
They disappeared when I wasn't looking..."
Yamato: "They don't seem to be enemies..."
Touya: "Well, they'll show up again if they need to."
Yamato: "But about that mech just now... It's strange
that the explosion was that small.
I can only think that mech absorbed it."
Touya: "Can it do that?"
Yamato: "An ordinary mech couldn't."
Kasumi: "It's mysterious."
Yamato: "Ah, it looks like everyone's arrived."
Touya: "All right, let's join up with them."
Rest: "...It looks like we've managed to finish this."
Touya: "Yeah. I'm glad you're all right, too."
Rest: "But... Maki..."
Arthur: "They're searching for her now, aren't they?
She'll be all right."
Fain: "Still, he's done something terrible..."
Arthur: "Yes. To think Prince Cain did something like this
just for revenge..."
Rest: "...So he approached President Horem
because he wanted the 'power'
to do this..."
Fain: "Princess, I don't know the details,
but did His Highness do something that terrible to Lord Rayfon?"
Celica: "...Yes... It's true that my brother
hurt Rayfon.
Right after that, Rayfon volunteered
for the ≪Ze=Ode≫ investigation team,
and was caught in the explosion three years ago..."
Touya: "Who is this Rayfon, anyway?"
Fain: "...Huh?"
Arthur: "Come to think of it, we haven't explained.
...Rayfon Lang Maxord.
The son of Grand Duke Gaharin, the king's younger brother. He wasn't an Alchemist,
but he helped design Armored Mechs
and distinguished himself as a Pilot, too.
He was presumed dead in the explosion three years ago, but..."
Agarthian Soldier: "Major! A report from the investigation team!
We've confirmed His Majesty is safe! Prince Tix
is in our protection, too!"
Celica: "M-My brother?!"
Agarthian Soldier: "Yes, ma'am... He still hasn't been... Ah!
We've found Lord Lodis!
He's safe! His Highness is safe!"
Celica: "...Thank goodness..."
Rest: "..."
Celica: "H-Hey, what about Maki?"
Agarthian Soldier: "Yes, ma'am. About that, on this channel..."
Rest: "?"
Maki: "Hi there..."
Rest: "Maki!"
Maki: "Were you worried?"
Rest: "Of course I was! Where are you now?!"
Maki: "The palace infirmary.
I'm using Reisuke to talk to you... Ugh."
Rest: "Are you all right?!"
Maki: "Y-Yeah.
Anyway, come to my room when you have a moment.
There's lots I want to talk about..."
Rest: "Yes, all right. Stay put and behave yourself."
Maki: "Okay. See you."
Touya: "...Well, that's one less thing to worry about for now."
Rest: "Yes. The soldiers have been freed
from the drug's hold, too. They're drained,
but there hasn't been any mental breakdown or side effects.
All that's left is the aftermath...?!"
Fain: "Master?"
Touya: "Is that the one from earlier?!"
Rest: "...Aidion! Why is it...?"
